name: Rotini Pasta with Oven-Roasted Shrimp, Cherry Tomatoes, Parsley & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Transfer shrimp to a large baking sheet pan, spreading them out in an even layer; season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice garlic. Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Add both to the baking sheet with the shrimp.
Wash and dry tomatoes; cut in half crosswise and add to the baking sheet.
Add oil and capers to the baking sheet, toss to combine, then spread everything out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle feta over the top of the shrimp and tomato mixture.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until tomatoes are soft and shrimp are cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander. Return pasta to the pot, cover, and set aside to keep warm.
When the shrimp and tomato mixture is done, carefully transfer to the pot with the pasta; add parsley and gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
